          Product description

          A ground-breaking adventure starring Donkey Kong.
          The big guy is back. Donkey Kong swings onto the Nintendo Switch 2 system with a brand-new action adventure.
          Help Donkey Kong make his way through the depths of the Underground World; the deeper he goes, the more amazing places he finds.
          There's no shortage of things DK can pulverize with his powerful punches. Let loose in this truly destructive adventure and help DK get his bananas back.
          Donkey Kong Bananza —only on Nintendo Switch 2.

          From the manufacturer

          DONKEY KONG BANANZA

          DIVE TO THE PLANET CORE!

          Join the unlikely duo of Donkey Kong and Pauline as they smash their way through a vast underground world in Donkey Kong Bananza – only on Nintendo Switch 2.

          BREAK IT DOWN!

          Bash through just about anything with the raw power of Donkey Kong! Crash through walls, carve tunnels with your fists, punch straight down into the ground, and even tear off chunks of terrain to swing around and throw – the more you smash, the more secrets you’ll open up to explore.

          UNLOCK POWERFUL NEW FORMS!

          By harnessing Bananzas, ancient powers passed down in the Underground World, Pauline’s singing can make DK transform into new animal forms. These transformations won’t last forever though, so use them wisely and gather up gold to keep your Bananergy topped up!

          TEAM UP WITH A FRIEND!

          Share a Joy-Con 2 controller with a friend to share the fun! Unleash vocal blasts using mouse controls to help DK attack enemies and destroy terrain. With GameShare, you can also invite a friend to join your co-op session using their own console, locally or online* with just one copy of the game.

          *GameShare via GameChat only available on Nintendo Switch 2 and requires a stable internet connection.

          Amazon Customer
          5 out of 5 stars
          One of the best platformers I've played
          If you enjoyed Super Mario Odyssey, Donkey Kong Bananza follows a similar formula but adds an enormous amount of destruction. You explore a variety of colourful worlds, hunting for bananas while completing platforming challenges and physics-based puzzles using Donkey Kong’s different abilities. What sets it apart is the freedom you’re given, with puzzles and exploration, you can smash through or reshape the environment to create your own route. The whole game is extremely polished and packed with content. It took me around 26 hours to complete the main story alongside some optional activities, but there’s still plenty left if I decide to go for 100%. It’s genuinely up there with the best platformers I’ve played and, in my opinion, is an essential purchase for the Switch 2.

          • Mars
            5 out of 5 stars
            Great game
            Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 10 October 2025
            Platform: Nintendo Switch 2Edition: physical
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            Donkey Kong Bonanza for the Nintendo Switch offers an exhilarating return to the jungle, blending classic platforming charm with fresh, vibrant game mechanics. The game welcomes players with its lush visuals, detailed environments, and that familiar, rhythmic soundtrack, designed to evoke nostalgia while introducing new auditory delights.

            The core gameplay is both challenging and rewarding, maintaining the essence of Donkey Kong's signature style. Players swing, jump, and barrel-blast through meticulously crafted levels, each filled with hidden secrets and clever puzzles. The controls are tight and responsive, making every leap over perilous gaps and dodge past menacing foes feel precise and satisfying.

            Donkey Kong Bonanza excels in its level design, offering diverse landscapes—from dense jungles and treacherous mountain peaks to underwater caverns brimming with surprises. The introduction of new power-ups and companions adds depth, encouraging creative strategies and replayability. Boss battles are particularly standout moments, requiring not just quick reflexes but thoughtful tactics to overcome.

            Multiplayer mode shines with seamless co-op gameplay, allowing friends to join in the adventure effortlessly. Whether tackling levels solo or with a partner, the game strikes a perfect balance between fun and difficulty, ensuring players of all skill levels remain engaged.

            While the game generally runs smoothly, occasional frame rate dips during action-heavy sequences slightly mar the otherwise polished experience. Nonetheless, Donkey Kong Bonanza is a triumphant addition to the franchise, celebrating its heritage while carving out new paths for future adventures.

            Donkey Kong Bananza is exactly the kind of game I hoped to see on the Nintendo Switch 2. The gameplay is fast, fun, and packed with personality, blending classic Donkey Kong charm with a fresh adventure full of exploration, platforming and destruction. The game follows Donkey Kong and Pauline as they journey through a vast underground world packed with secrets, collectibles and unique environments. [nintendo.com], [nintendo.com]

            One of the standout features is how much of the environment you can smash and interact with. Tearing through walls, carving tunnels and uncovering hidden areas never seems to get old, and it adds a satisfying sense of discovery to every level.

            The visuals are colourful and polished, the controls feel responsive, and the various transformations keep the gameplay feeling fresh throughout the adventure. The optional co-op mode is also a great addition for playing with friends or family.

            What impressed me most is that the game captures the fun and creativity Nintendo is known for. Whether you're a long-time Donkey Kong fan or simply looking for a great platforming adventure on Switch 2, there's plenty here to enjoy.

            Overall, Donkey Kong Bananza is a fantastic first-party Nintendo title that's packed with charm, replay value and genuinely enjoyable gameplay.

          • Lloyd
            5 out of 5 stars
            An explosive return for the King of Kong – Bananza is pure joy
            Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 2 August 2025
            Platform: Nintendo Switch 2Edition: physical
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            Donkey Kong Bananza isn’t just a return — it’s a glorious, banana-scented mic drop from Nintendo. It’s chaotic, punchy, inventive, and bursting with that signature DK charm — only now cranked up to 11.

            From the second I slammed through the floor of Ingot Isle, I was grinning. The destructible environments are genius — nearly everything can be smashed, thrown, or used to uncover secrets. It's the first time a Donkey Kong game has felt like it truly rewards being a curious little gremlin.

            The layered world design is a massive win. No loading screens, just vertical traversal between beautifully crafted zones full of challenges, secrets, and weird jungle nonsense. It’s like DK met Metroid, but instead of brooding silently, he just punched a wall open.

            The new transformation powers? Ridiculously fun. Zebra DK had me zooming across levels like a feral Mario Kart. Ostrich DK? Graceful, floaty chaos. The Banandium upgrades let you customise your playstyle — do you want to be a tactical explorer or a full-on ape rampage machine? Your choice.

            It’s not flawless — the camera has a couple of wonky moments, and there’s the odd frame stutter — but honestly, it doesn’t matter. The vibe, the flow, the “one more level” addiction... it all clicks.

            Nintendo has finally given DK the 3D platformer he deserves, and it slaps harder than a Kong handstand. If you’ve ever loved platformers, this is a must-play. And if you haven’t? This’ll probably convert you.

            10/10 — I came for bananas, I stayed for destruction.

          • ellis
            5 out of 5 stars
            Lots of DK Fun 😁
            Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 17 September 2025
            Platform: Nintendo Switch 2Edition: physical
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            Donkey Kong Bananza is a bold, exciting new entry in the Donkey Kong franchise that blends classic charm with modern, open-ended platforming. It launches exclusively on the Switch 2, and it delivers on many of the promises fans have been quietly hoping for.

            👍 What Works Really Well

            Destructible Environments: One of the game’s biggest strengths is its destructible terrain—you can smash, dig, punch through walls, and carve out new paths. It makes exploration feel dynamic and satisfying.

            Variety of Transformations: DK can use different “Bananza” animal forms (like zebra, ostrich, etc.) that change how you move, explore or deal with obstacles. These transformations keep the gameplay fresh and help solve exploration puzzles in satisfying ways.

            Visuals and Presentation: The visuals are impressive; expressive animations, colourful worlds, lots of detail. It uses the hardware of Switch 2 well, especially when it comes to environmental detail and effects.

            Exploration & Collectibles: There’s a strong incentive to explore: Banandium Gems, fossils, secrets, hidden paths, collectibles everywhere. This makes the game feel rich and long-lasting.

            Co-op & Pauline’s Role: The inclusion of Pauline as a co-op partner adds a nice touch. Her abilities (like using her voice/music) play into puzzles and exploration, which brings in new dynamics.

            👀 What’s Less Strong / Could Be Improved

            Camera Issues: In tight or underground spaces, when digging or moving dynamically through destructible terrain, the camera sometimes struggles. You can lose sight of your path or get disoriented.

            Story is Serviceable but Not Deep: The narrative works fine to drive the game forward, but it’s not what this game is truly about—it’s more about the journey, the exploration, the mechanics. If you want a deeply emotional or complex storyline, this isn't it.

            Co-op Feels Limited: While co-op is fun, some critics feel it's not quite as fleshed-out as single-player mode—it can sometimes feel like an add-on rather than a fully developed cooperative experience.

            ⭐ Verdict

            Overall, Donkey Kong Bananza is one of the Switch 2’s strongest titles so far. It captures what many players want: big, playful, adventurous platforming, lots of surprises, and the joy of discovery. If you enjoy exploration, smashing through things, and uncovering hidden secrets, this game gives you tons of that.

            I never really knew what the game was about at first so didn't actually like it at the start. Once I realised it was mostly about just smashing up the maps and exploring doing challenges it was quite fun and addictive. I think this has been my most played switch 2 game so far around 40-50 hours and still didn.t do everything, just finished the main story and a lot of random exploring. However most of this time is probably because the limited time event that was on.

            You play through a story while exploring the different worlds or layers all that have a different theme. Lots of variety in the zones. Lots of hidden things to find and discover, challenges and puzzles, talents/skills to unlock as well as different animal forms you can unlock with their own powers and abilities all make for a entertaining game. You can also just go round destroying the whole map near enough if you want.

            The game was good fun overall and I did enjoy it but it sometimes had a weird feeling. I felt there was a lot of variety in the zones, abilities and challenges but also sometimes it felt a bit repetitive. I played it over a few weeks or month or 2 and always had fun but i feel if i tried to do it all at once i might get bored.

            This is a massive Game! It's crazy and a lot of fun because you can break anything you want with the power of Donkey Kong's fists. In the game itself you're accompanied by an odd purple rock which falls from the sky to the ground and turns out to be Pauline, a young 13 year old girl who is inspired to become a singer. Donkey Kong can break through rocks on order to find gold in various mines in each layer and also finding Golden Bananas known as Banandium Gems and also find your way down to the Planet Core to find the Banandium Root by chasing after the 3 villainous Kongs lead by Void Kong, a mean nasty Kong who runs a mining company and having the power to turn everything purple with a push of a button with a remote control shaped of a banana in his hand. The power of the Bananza gives Donkey Kong the ability to transform into a Hyper Kong known as Kong Bananza which gives Donkey Kong strong super powers to bash through tough walls that he can't do in normal form plus other forms of Bananza Powers that he can transform into including a Zebra, Ostrich, Elephant and a Snake with their own set of powers as well. You can break through plenty of rocks to search for Gold, Fossils, treasure chests for gold and maps to the location for fossils and Banandium Gems but be very careful while bashing through rocks, otherwise you, fall to your death.

            Donkey Kong Bananza is a must play game and good to have a 3D Donkey Kong game for the first time for 26 years since Donkey Kong 64 in 1999 and its worth every penny.

            Fun for all generations (even if I was just the sidekick!)
            Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 8 April 2026
            Platform: Nintendo Switch 2Edition: physical

            I bought Donkey Kong Bananza to play with my grandson on his new Switch 2, and we have both absolutely loved it. It's easily one of the most fun games we’ve played together in a long time.

            The co-op mode is brilliant for playing with younger kids. My grandson naturally took the lead as Donkey Kong, doing all the heavy lifting and smashing through the levels, while I got relegated to playing as Pauline! I spent most of the time sitting on Donkey Kong’s shoulder, which we both found hilarious.

            Why it’s a great family buy:

            Perfect Co-op: Playing as Pauline is actually quite helpful—I could help him out with her singing abilities to trigger transformations and blast enemies while he focused on the platforming.

            Stunning Visuals: The underground worlds are beautiful, and being able to smash almost anything in the environment kept my grandson entertained for hours.

            Great Pacing: The game is challenging enough to keep it interesting but accessible enough that we didn't get frustrated.

            Funny Moments: There’s a lot of humor in the animations, especially the way Pauline hitches a ride on DK.

            If you’re looking for a game to play with a grandchild, this is a winner. It doesn't matter if you're the one doing the smashing or just the one "sitting on the shoulder"—you’ll both have a blast!
